The '''Duros Allied Army''' was a military unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At her debutante cotillion, [[Rivoche Tarkin]] learned from a [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] of a planned CompForce attack against insurgents within the Duros Allied Army. She passed the information on to an [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Academy]] cadet that she knew had "[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|questionable]]" friends&mdash;[[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]. The CompForce assault on the insurgents failed, and Rivoche Tarkin began her career as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Alliance.<ref name="CRO" />
